cueCard.topic: Describe something you bought that you were very pleased with.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you were pleased with it.

questions.text: Describe something you bought that you were very pleased with.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe something you bought that you were very pleased with. You should say: what it was; where you bought it; how much it cost; and explain why you were pleased with it.

questions.text: Would you buy something like this again?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you buy something like this again?

questions.text: Why do some people enjoy shopping so much?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about something you bought that you were pleased with, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all shopping habits. Why do some people enjoy shopping so much?

questions.text: Has online shopping been good for small local shops?
questions.say: Has online shopping been good for small local shops?

questions.text: Do people buy more things than they really need?
questions.say: Do people buy more things than they really need?

questions.text: How does advertising influence what children want?
questions.say: Now let's talk about advertising. How does advertising influence what children want?

questions.text: Should there be stricter rules about advertising?
questions.say: Should there be stricter rules about advertising?

questions.text: Do you think advertisements on social media are more effective than on television?
